name: Onna Kyoushi Yuuko "Watashi, Mou... Kono Kyoushitsu kara Nukedasenai no...?"
original_name: 女教師・ゆうこ「ワタシ、もう…この教室から抜け出せないの…？」
source: Asuhara Yuuko, a beautiful and intelligent teacher leaves a prestigious school in the city to work in a rural school. She has a troubled past as a victim of stalking at her previous job, so she transferred to escape and start fresh in her new workplace. The new school, unfortunately, has Narimiya Keisuke, the protagonist, who possesses an evidence from Yuuko's past that she wants to forget. He develops a dark obsession with Yuuko and begins to use her troubled past to manipulate her. Keisuke disguises himself a fictitious blackmailer and gives her obscene orders using pictures from the fake blackmailing website. His orders escalate, and soon the entire school becomes involved in a debauched and immoral affair.
translation: 美丽聪慧的教师明日原优子离开城里的名门学校，转入一所乡村学校任教。她在上一份工作中曾遭人跟踪，为逃离那段痛苦过去、在新环境重新开始才选择转职。不幸的是，新学校里有主人公成宫圭介；他掌握着优子竭力想忘记的过去证据。圭介对优子产生阴暗执念，并开始利用她的创伤操纵她。他伪装成虚构的勒索者，借助假勒索网站上的照片向她下达淫秽命令。要求不断升级，很快，整所学校都被卷入一场堕落而不道德的事件。
